node.title: KoalaBear c2 (1,1,2) near positive fixed-xi mixed exclusion
node.closure: the deployed-field positive near-aligned fixed-moving xi=a mixed residual-allocation chart is empty
node.statement: Over the deployed KoalaBear field F_(2130706433^6), normalize the positive near-aligned fixed-moving chart by a=xi=2, eta=c, ell=d and w=1/c, and require both residual quadratics to be proportional to (W-1/2)(W-1/d). After explicit forbidden factors are removed, the within-fiber resultants share one bidegree-(8,6) curve. Projecting its intersections with the two cross-product and three cross-sum factors gives degree-96 and degree-186 univariate certificates whose squarefree gcd is (d-2)(d-1)(2d-1). An independent fraction-free opposite projection gives (c-2)(c-1)(2c-1). Both identities persist modulo p=2130706433, so this necessary q-slice chart is empty; the other fifteen affine positive charts, projective boundary, and negative loci remain open.
